reason: Mutation testing, tool-independent slice (#486, fork F6(b)): module-size 45119->45778 (+659), re-measured with `harness check-arch` (CLI 12.10.0) in a clean isolated worktree against merge base main 1f69dcd2. The earlier 45194 in this file described NEITHER side of a baselines.json merge conflict -- it was this branch's pre-merge value, measured against the older base 7f33d1cb, and the merged tree actually measures higher; 45778 is the measured value of the tree this allowance ships with, not a carried-over number. newViolations is [] and the only regression is this aggregate. The growth is the feature: ts/src/guardian/mutation.ts (the model and the runner-compatibility abstain guard) and ts/src/guardian/mutation-report.ts (Stryker-report mapping, abstention rules including the timeout stance, canary:allow-mutant suppressions and rendering), plus the `mutation` subcommand in guardian/cli.ts. The module is split across two files ONLY because a single 525-line module tripped the perf ratchet's 300-line delta rule as a new finding; splitting was the fix rather than an allowance. This revision also DELETES the unused scope/cap scaffolding (mutateEntries, sampleMutants, MUTANT_CAP, SampleResult and their constants, ~55 source lines with zero production callers), so the number is lower than it would otherwise be. A first draft also raised two new complexity violations (mutationCmd at 14 and an inline IIFE at 12 against a threshold of 10) and a parameterCount violation in a semver comparator; all three were fixed in code by extracting mappedStrykerReport / mutatedSources / guardAbstention and by ranking versions numerically, not allowed.
